candidates.title: Persistent Account & Existing Pet Finder
candidates.change: Redesign the sign-in options to include a dedicated 'Find Existing Desktop Pet' button and active account sync status card right above credentials.
candidates.why: 8 support emails mentioned pets being missing or reset after signing back in, causing account confusion during setup.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Sync & Protect Your Desktop Pet

sign_in_options.label: Continue with Existing Account & Restore Pet

sign_in_options.text: Your pet data is automatically linked to your account email.

guard.reason: 'sign_in.replace.sign_in_options[0].label' must be text up to 40 characters

candidates.title: Pet Trait & Personality Customizer Screen
candidates.change: Insert a new pet trait selection screen right before photo uploads to let users pick pet behaviors (playful, calm, vocal) prior to visual generation.
candidates.why: Adoption has the highest funnel dropoff (60.9% conversion) and users complained that custom generated pets looked wrong or failed.

pick_friend.hint: Next, choose your pet's personality traits before customization.

guard.reason: _order names screens that are neither onboarding screens nor defined here: ['new_pet_traits']

candidates.title: Live Pet Creation Progress & Desk Preview
candidates.change: Enhance the waiting screen with detailed generation progress stages (rigging, sprite rendering, desktop sync) and desktop location previews.
candidates.why: The waiting screen takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, while 3 support tickets noted pets failing to show on desktop.

components.text: Your pet will automatically anchor to your primary desktop monitor once ready.

guard.reason: Enhances waiting screen information and timing progress, which is explicitly allowed.

candidates.score_note: High evidence from mean time (2336s) and 3 support tickets; requires rich custom UI work.

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Controls Tray Spotlight
candidates.change: Redesign the final screen into a stage layout highlighting desktop taskbar controls, pet hide/show hotkeys, and voice/chat buttons.
candidates.why: Finish conversion is 64.8% with long completion times, and support received multiple emails about how to hide or interact with desktop pets.

home_intro.headline: Your Desktop Pet is Ready!
home_intro.body: Control your pet anytime from the system tray or desktop hotkeys.

home_welcome.text: Press Alt+P to summon or hide your pet. Right-click taskbar icon for settings.

guard.reason: 'home_intro.replace.home_welcome[0]': a choice_cards cannot do the home_welcome job (use ['animation', 'button', 'checklist', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'])

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate First Flow Sequence
candidates.change: Place the introductory story step immediately into a card layout before path choice to build emotional investment before option selection.
candidates.why: Choose path takes 8s median / 514s mean with 79.1% dropoff; setting story context first improves user engagement.

choose_path.headline: Choose How You Want to Meet Your Companion

guard.reason: Updates choose_path layout while preserving all required onboarding steps and sequence.

candidates.score_note: Choose_path dropoff is moderate (20.9%) and lacks support ticket evidence; sequence change needs UI build.

candidates.title: Photo Quality Requirements & Fail-Safe Guidance
candidates.change: Add photo selection quality guidelines (bright lighting, single subject) and automatic fallback pet selector options on the photo upload screen.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet photo generation failures or poor output quality during adoption.

upload_photos.hint: For best results, use well-lit photos with a clear view of your pet's face.

components.text: Avoid blurry images or photos with multiple pets.

guard.reason: Adds helpful guidance components to the photo upload screen without violating any base rules.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has highest dropoff (39.1%) backed by 3 tickets; hints and fallbacks address directly.

candidates.title: Account Protection & Pet Restoration Guarantee
candidates.change: Update the sign-in headline and body copy to reassure users that signing in backs up their custom pet progress across devices.
candidates.why: Sign-in dropoff is 27.1% and 8 users complained about pet loss after re-authenticating.

sign_in.headline: Save Your Companion to Cloud Account
sign_in.body: Signing in ensures your pet settings, memory, and customization are never lost if you switch devices.
sign_in.hint: Already created a pet? Sign in with the same email to restore it.

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.hint' asks for or mentions personal data

candidates.title: First Desktop Playdate Reward Challenge
candidates.change: Offer a bonus pet accessory badge for completing the desktop intro tour and giving the pet its first treat.
candidates.why: Finish screen median duration is 395s with only 64.8% completion; rewards motivate finishing setup.

guard.reason: Mentions claiming a reward/accessory in onboarding copy, violating the prohibition on mentioning gifts or free extras.

candidates.title: Stage Layout Path Selector
candidates.change: Switch the choose_path screen layout to a stage layout to highlight path options clearly without overwhelming the user.
candidates.why: Path selection mean time is high (514s), suggesting users spend too long deciding or get confused.

guard.reason: Changes choose_path screen layout to stage layout while retaining its essential function.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high decision time on choose_path, but lacks support ticket validation.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Ready Sound & Desktop System Notification
candidates.change: Enable audio notification and desktop pop-up alerts when pet generation finishes during the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Waiting step has a huge mean time (2336s), indicating users tab away during long setup times.

guard.reason: Adds notification settings and audio chime to the waiting screen, which is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Directly targets massive mean wait time (2336s) by re-engaging tabbed-away users.
